evidence_scope_projection.definition: Overall prostate cancer evidence, excluding estimates solely about aggressive prostate cancer. General estimates from papers that also report aggressive endpoints remain included. Uncertain endpoints retain their existing review and pooling restrictions.

headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger’s test is generally not recommended when fewer than 10 studies are available.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 2 studies yielded an effect size of 0.8 (95% CI: 0.24–2.64), indicating no statistically significant association between oleic acid and prostate cancer\aggressive. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 82.04%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
